review_method: Actual view_image inspection of raw full-body PNG, compared to actual viewed approved Sela G. PIL used only for non-mutating metadata.
observations: 灰发、短灰须、下垂眉与闭口传达年长、忧虑和克制。
橄榄旧外衣、浅围巾、棕色闭合药袋均可辨，无治疗动作。
头部大、颈短、靴短，但目测余身仍略长于头，接近1:1.2而非严格1:1。
像素簇比Sela G略细，外衣细节较多；未冒称与基准完全同密度。
limits: Raw generated concept kept intact; no quantization, downsample or postprocess.
Not production sprite, animation, collision, native dimensions or game runtime acceptance.
Identity/outfit appearance remains Mod-original art proposal, not canonical original-game appearance.
